title: The Annihilating Light
wikitext:
{{Item |rarity_id = unique |name = The Annihilating Light |class_id = Staff |base_item = Quarterstaff |required_level = 68 |flavour_text = There is no force more destructive in the heavens
than the scintillating light of utter clarity. |explicit1 = IncreasedElementalResistancesUnique__2_ |explicit2 = ElementalSkillsTripleDamageUnique__1 |inventory_icon = The Annihilating Light |release_version = 3.17.0 |drop_text = Drops from [[Uber Exarch]]. |is_drop_restricted = true }} '''The Annihilating Light''' is a [[unique]] {{il|Quarterstaff}}. ==Mechanics== * "[[Triple Damage]]" only applies to damage dealt by hits. [[Damage over time]] effects, such as [[Ignite]] or [[Righteous Fire]] are not directly affected. * "Elemental Skills" refer to any skill with the Fire, Cold, or Lightning tags. This includes [[Spell]]s, [[Attack]]s, and [[Warcry|Warcries]]. This also includes other difficult-to-scale things such as [[Glove enchantment]]s and [[Herald]]s. ** Minions skills do not inherently deal damage; they summon a minion which deals damage. Triple damage would not apply to Elemental Minions in this case. * #% [[reduced resistance]]s ('''NOT''' a {{c|mod|-#% to Resistances}}) is an additive modifier to other {{c|mod|increase/reduced Resistances}} mods. Similar mod can be found on [[Oil#List of Blight uniques|Blight unique helmets]] and other items such as {{il|Glimpse of Chaos}}; while [[Tempered by War]] has {{c|mod|50% less Cold/Lightning Resistance}}, which is multiplicative to {{c|mod|increase/reduce Resistances}} instead of being additive. * Negative Resists will become less negative, so it has anti-synergy with [[Doryani's Prototype]]. *There is a cap of {{c|mod|100% reduced resistances}} in-game{{section link|Version 3.17.0|Reduced Resistances}} so that you can never invert positive resistances into negative, or vice versa. At 100% reduced Resistances, your Resists will permanently be at 0. ** With a {{c|mod|60% reduced Elemental Resistances}} roll, starting from -60% baseline (post Act 10 Kitava), you would need a total of {{c|mod|+247.5% to Fire Resistance}} to reach 75% fire resistance. (same for cold/lightning) ** With a {{c|mod|70% reduced Elemental Resistances}} roll, starting from -60% baseline (post Act 10 Kitava), you would need {{c|mod|+310% to Fire Resistance}} to reach 75% fire resistance. (same for cold/lightning) ===Strategies=== * Using this staff with any [[Cowl]] helmet (e.g. {{il|Cowl of the Thermophile}}; consequentially gaining >100% reduced Resistances) will cause your non-overridden resist to permanently be at 0, and will not invert them. Even with Thermophile + [[Divine Flesh]] or [[Tempered by War]], you would still be taking half of all Cold and Lightning damage to 0 Cold/Lightning Res. * {{il|Incandescent Heart}} + [[Divine Flesh]] is an option to take 75% of Elemental Hits and 50% of Elemental DOTs as Chaos damage (to avoid investing into elemental resists); this allows the use of {{il|Glimpse of Chaos}} as long as you remove the line {{c|mod|Chaos Resistance is Zero}} with a {{il|Vaal Orb}}. * [[Transcendence (keystone passive)|Transcendence]] is another option, stacking [[Armour]] and additional Physical Damage Reduction. * {{il|Crystallised Omniscience}} can provide large amounts of Elemental Resistances, as well as Elemental Penetration, making it a nice synergistic unique. {{Item acquisition}} ==Legacy variants== The Annihilating Light has a [[legacy variant]]. {{legacy variant table header}} {{legacy variant table row|3.25.0| *{{c|mod|+18% Chance to Block Attack Damage while wielding a Staff}} | * (70-60)% reduced Elemental Resistances * Deal Triple Damage with Elemental Skills }} {{Legacy variant table end}} ==Gallery== File:The Annihilating Light 3D.png|3D ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * This item's basetype's implicit modifier was changed. }} {{Version history table row|3.24.0| * The Annihilating Light is now an [[Uber Exarch]] boss drop. {{Undocumented}} }} {{Version history table row|3.17.0| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==See also== * [[Double damage]] * [[Triple damage]] ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Unique Items}} [[Category:Unique staves with 3D art]]
